      Welcome to the casino! How do you want to play?

      Accounts are free and need no email. On the Claude link they stay saved even when the game updates.

      Make an account

      Pick any name and a password you'll remember.
      On the device that has your account, press Esc and choose "Use my account on another device". Type the code it shows here.

      Playing as Guest

      You start in the lobby with $1,000. Ring the Loan Shark's phone, then walk through the doors to the casino. Each floor is one day: make the money before the timer runs out and the elevator takes you up. Run out of time and… look down 😱. Floor 1: $5,000 in 5 minutes. Playing with friends? Everyone starts with $1,000, but the amount you need goes up.

      Playing with friends? In the casino press P (or Esc, then Party) to create or join a party.

        Roulette, blackjack, slots, the Big Six wheel and Over / Under 7 dice are all on the floor.

        CASINOWITHFRIENDS

        Do tasks to earn ⭐ points, then spend them at the shop outside. Tasks start over each new run. Press T any time to see them.

          Your colour

          In a party everyone shares ONE pot of money. Every player adds $1,000 to it, so more friends means more money. You make the quota together. Hold Tab to see who made and who lost money.

          Friends not signed in to Claude? Play parties on the game website instead. No sign-in needed!
